guidance: Forced Monster row4/col6 on the right path. Ironclad is 68/80 HP with Strength Potion, temporary Guilty curse and Uppercut, Tremble, Rampage, Iron Wave, Pommel Strike and Setup Strike. There are further forced Monster nodes before row7 Rest Site; preserve HP rather than hoarding potion while taking large damage. Use Uppercut's Weak on a meaningful attack turn and compare actual incoming to block and kills, including any status end-turn effects. A Strength Potion should be used if it materially shortens a dangerous fight, not automatically on a harmless turn. Claim all rewards/cards and stop at floor5 MAP, terminal or HP danger review.
